patient_label.description: A non-identifying label for the patient/session, e.g. 'Room 204' or 'Patient A' (never a real name in demo data)

shift.description: Shift context if mentioned, e.g. 'Day shift', 'Night shift'

vitals.description: Leave any field as null if not mentioned in the transcript

subjective.description: What the patient reported/complained of, in their own words where possible

objective.description: Observable/measurable findings the nurse noted (beyond vitals) — e.g. wound appearance, mobility, alertness

actions_taken.description: Concrete care actions performed, e.g. 'Administered 500mg Tylenol at 14:00', 'Repositioned patient'

assessment.description: Nurse's brief clinical impression of patient status, if stated

plan.description: Follow-up actions, things to monitor, or handoff notes for the next shift

flags.description: Anything the model is unsure about or that seemed ambiguous in the transcript — surfaced to the nurse for review rather than guessed at
